content: ऊर्जः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the month Kārtika (as giving vigour and energy); ‘बाहुलोर्जौ कार्तिकिकः’ इत्यमरः; ऊर्जमतङ्गजम् <ls>Śi. 6. 50</ls>. .²2 Energy. .²3 Power, strength. .²4 Procreative power. .²5 Life, breath. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of the sons of हिरण्यगर्भ (reckoned among the seven Ṛṣis of the third Manvantara). .{@-र्जा@} .²1 Food ऊर्जावती (गङ्गा) <ls>Mb. 13. 26. 84</ls>. .²2 Energy. .²3 Strength, sap. नाप्यूर्जां बिभरामास वैदेह्यां प्रसितो भृशम् <ls>Bk. 6. 3</ls>. .²4 Growth. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Vasiṣṭha. .{@-र्जम्@} Water.
